participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: Every season the money seems to end up somewhere other than the walls, and we only find out once the invoices land. Before another budget is set I would rather know which parts of a season quietly swallow it.

participants.name: Kenji

persona.name: Kenji
persona.personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.

participants.private_seed: Delivery is where this committee keeps getting caught out, approving something in good faith and then spending the season apologising at the door. I want to know where past seasons actually came unstuck, not where they were meant to.

participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: Looking back over the seasons I have sat through, the shows we were proudest of on paper are not the ones people came back for. Before the main room is committed again, the record should get a hearing first.

participants.name: Daisuke

persona.name: Daisuke
persona.personality: Daisuke is very introverted and cautious, and tends to be somewhat passive when interacting with others. He finds it difficult to express his feelings and thoughts to others, and often struggles with his emotions internally. He is kind and very compassionate when it comes to helping others, but at times he lacks confidence in himself and struggles with inner conflict. He has a quiet personality, and occasionally his emotions become overwhelming, leading to periods of low mood. However, as he becomes able to rely on those around him, he gradually regains his composure.

participants.private_seed: The main room has to go on working as a building and not only as a display, and every season something arrives that the floor or the diary cannot absorb. I would rather learn that before the space is promised to anyone.

participants.name: Rin

persona.name: Rin
persona.personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. She can be a little precocious at times, and when she is with her older brothers and sisters, she makes mature comments and comes up with interesting ideas. She is very curious and loves adventure and trying new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, often surprising and amusing those around her, but her cheerful personality makes her loved by everyone.

participants.private_seed: We keep planning seasons as though the staff list were still what it was five years ago, when those left are carrying two roles each. What I want settled is who would actually do the work and who would be standing in the room.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a special exhibition for a museum's main gallery. Five members of a museum's exhibition committee review the proposals submitted by curators and partner institutions. One exhibition will occupy the main gallery next season. Participants: Benjamin, Kenji, Toshio, Daisuke and Rin. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Loan transport costs over three seasons
- Mount-making charges and joiner's rate
- Lender paperwork against shipping cut-offs
- Maintenance log for powered displays
- Weekend head counts across ten seasons
- Five years of visitor comment slips
- Structural survey of the suspended bay
- Evening hire bookings in the gallery
- Conservation lab staffing and backlog
- Composition of the volunteer roster

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Daisuke, Toshio, Rin, Kenji and Benjamin. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
